text:
Predicates:
LibraryWorker(x) ::: x works in the library.
CSDept(x) ::: x is from the computer science department.
PartTimeJob(x) ::: x has a part-time job offered by the university.
DatabaseCourse(x) ::: x takes the database course.
Instructed(x, y) ::: x is instructed by professor y.
LabWorker(x) ::: x works in the lab.
Premises:
∀x (LibraryWorker(x) → ¬CSDept(x)) ::: No students who work in the library are from the computer science department.
∀x (PartTimeJob(x) → LibraryWorker(x)) ::: All students who have part-time jobs offered by the university are students who work in the library.
∀x (DatabaseCourse(x) → CSDept(x)) ::: All students who take the database course are from the computer science department.
∀x (Instructed(x, david) → DatabaseCourse(x)) ::: All students instructed by professor David are taking the database course.
∀x (LabWorker(x) → Instructed(x, david)) ::: All students working in the lab are instructed by professor David.
LabWorker(james) ::: James is a student working in the lab.
¬(PartTimeJob(jack) ∨ LabWorker(jack)) ::: Jack neither has a part-time job offered by the university nor works in the lab.
Conclusion:
∃x (PartTimeJob(james)) ::: James has a part-time job offered by the university.
